{{Otheruses|Moonlight}}
'''Moonlight Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] that flew as part of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Mon Casima]]''.<ref name="adumar">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040401adumarmain|text=Adumar: Pilots Wanted|int=Adumar: Pilots Wanted}}</ref>

[[Cartann Ground Champion]] [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] became a member of this squadron.<ref name="adumar" />
